summary.text: Laura Sirot is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a professor and associate chair of Biology at The College of Wooster.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Laura Sirot said she has lived and worked in Wooster for the past 15 years and that her research focuses on the reproductive biology of insect vectors of human pathogens and agricultural pests.
She said she co-founded the Wooster Science Café, has been a foster parent for Wayne County Children Services, adopted a child through foster care and serves on its board.
Sirot listed support for public education, including full funding of the Fair School Funding Plan and reversing Senate Bill 1, and affordability among her key campaign messages.
